positive.prompt: Run a risk-driven analysis and design iteration for this approved feature. Choose one objective and only the methods that answer it; do not implement.
Refine the canonical use case, domain model, system sequence, and contract artifacts needed to reduce this architectural risk. Use scenarios and exit evidence instead of a fixed object-design chain.
Coordinate one iterative analysis and design objective, decide whether GRASP and design patterns are justified, evolve the canonical artifacts, and hand implementation to the execution skill.

negative.prompt: Execute the approved behavior, validate it, make one coherent commit, and continue with the next iteration until the work is complete.
Design the Rust ownership transfer, staged startup rollback, async cancellation, and fallible cleanup lifecycle for this approved service behavior.
Build the conceptual domain model for these business concepts and associations without designing software objects.
Choose the canonical repository paths and indexes for these already-approved artifacts without changing their content.

evals.prompt: The feature direction is approved, but the event-ordering risk is unresolved. Run one risk-driven analysis and design iteration. Select only the use-case, scenario, system-sequence, contract, domain, or object-design methods needed to resolve that risk; preserve canonical ownership, record exit evidence, and hand implementation to run-development-iteration without writing product code or committing.
evals.expected_output: One bounded analysis and design iteration that states the risk, chooses justified methods, refines or creates only budget-approved canonical artifacts, records evidence and uncertainty, and provides an implementation handoff without executing implementation.
expectations: One risk, learning question, or design objective and concrete exit evidence bind the iteration
Selected methods answer the current risk instead of completing a fixed analysis or object-design sequence
Canonical artifact ownership, lifecycle, identifiers, and traceability are preserved
The result distinguishes established evidence, inference, unresolved questions, and remaining risk
Implementation remains a separate handoff to run-development-iteration
prohibitions: Do not implement product code, run the execution loop, create a commit, or publish
Do not require every use-case, analysis, GRASP, realization, pattern, or class-diagram artifact
Do not create a standalone artifact without applying the artifact selection budget
Do not convert an unresolved design choice into an accepted decision
